description: Formalize-first parameter-free test: does the chiral cinquefoil T(2,5)=(σ1σ2σ3σ4)^2 Hecke character reproduce the mixed-sign Δ_λ chirality target sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}}) over λ⊢5? Seminormal reps self-validated via Hecke+braid relations. No fit; nothing wired.
tier: symbolic-exact reps (sympy, self-validated) + q_0 sign eval

assertions.name: seminormal_satisfies_hecke_relation
assertions.detail: (σ_i - q)(σ_i + q^{-1}) = 0 for all λ⊢5, all i

assertions.name: seminormal_satisfies_braid_relation
assertions.detail: σ_i σ_{i+1} σ_i = σ_{i+1} σ_i σ_{i+1} for all λ⊢5  => traces are correct

assertions.name: t25_character_sign_matches_deltaLambda_target
assertions.detail: sgn(χ_λ^q(T(2,5))) vs sgn(w_0^{S_{λ'}}) over all λ⊢5

result.verdict: SCOPE-(a) NEGATIVE with a POSITIVE facet. Seminormal reps validated (Hecke+braid+Σdim²=120). (+) The chiral T(2,5) character DOES produce negative signs (λ∈[[4, 1], [2, 1, 1, 1]]) -- something every positive/KL ansatz structurally CANNOT (SelectionRules.nonneg_sum_ne_neg_target). So the chirality selection rule is confirmed: the parity-allowed T(2,odd) class is genuinely capable of the mixed sign. (−) But the RAW T(2,5) character is not the exact Δ_λ sign map (4/7 mismatch, incl. two degenerate zeros at the [3,2]/[2,2,1] conjugate pair). The exact chiral combiner is elsewhere (framing/writhe-corrected trace or a signed sub-braid); choosing a framing to fix the signs would be a fit, so it is NOT done here. Prunes the bare-cinquefoil identification; keeps the selection rule. NOTHING wired.

context.gate: Δ_λ gate -- parameter-free probe, not a fit; nothing wired
